descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de produse pentru apărare și domeniul spațial, Linii aeriene și aviație și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Would you like to become part of a dedicated team that has a crucial role in our ability to deliver meaningful high-tech solutions to keep people safe?
 We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes, as we deliver advanced technologies and mission critical solutions for the defense and aerospace industry. Our systems provide security for people on land, at sea and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for a Senior Purchasing profile in our Electricals category to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.
 Your role in our team
 With reference to the Manager of EGSE Procurement, you are offered a unique possibility to join our team on the journey towards securing people through advanced technology. You will be part of supply chain team in the EGSE procurement category where you will work closely together with both internal and external stakeholders.
Main responsibility:
 As part of the EGSE procurement team, you will be responsible for various categories such as electricals, electromechanical and IT hardware for our EGSE category (Electrical ground support equipments). To be successful in this position you will help develop and drive the category, executing cost saving initiatives and select the right supplier base. You will be responsible for maintaining, updating, and monitoring the supplier database for purchased parts, ensuring that all relevant supplier and part information is complete, accurate, and up to date.You will be working cross-functionally with stakeholders across Terma and help facilitate requirements from our R&D and sales organization. Furthermore, you will support and drive category specific KPIs and ensure we remain on target.
 Your professional qualifications:
 You will have a relevant educational background within e.g., supply chain, procurement, logistics or engineering and have experience with the sourcing process. You are used to dealing with multiple stakeholders and know the value of developing supplier relationships. Furthermore, we expect the ideal candidate to possess below qualifications as well:
2+ years of experience from a similar job function is an advantage
Experience from negotiation and the sourcing process
Experience with electrical components and IT hardware is an advantage
Fluent in English is a requirement
Strong skills in Microsoft Office package, with emphasis on Excel
 Your personal qualifications:
 As a person you have a positive mindset and see solutions instead of obstacles and possess the below skills:
Independent and a positive mindset
Able to deliver results as part of a team alongside working individually with other projects 
Strong communication skills 
Analytical with a high drive and natural curiosity 
 What can Terma offer?
 You will become part of Denmark's leading company in the defense and space industry, contributing to solutions that protect critical infrastructure, enhance coastal and airport surveillance, and support our space business in general.
To us it is about owning the responsibility and taking part in defining the right supplier setup. We want you to be part of developing Terma of tomorrow and alongside leaving your own mark in the process. Our culture is informal and direct supported with genuine leadership and can-do attitude.
 Further information:
 For further information about the position please contact Oana Olteanu at oano@terma.com
 We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible via www.terma.com.
Applications will be processed continuously.
